RT @McLarenF1: Post-Quali thoughts with OP 💭 #McLarenF1 | #OKXxMcLarenF1 | #ItalianGP 🇮🇹 https://t.co/RpIcYeop22

Oscar in the press conference: "The second lap, I was leading the train around and I was already like 2 tenths down so i tried to sort of compensate. Obviously your breaking point changes quite a lot with that speed difference so I tried to be probably a bit too ambitious, locked the front and that was it. I think the first lap was pretty solid to be honest so not too disappointed. I think there was only a few guys who improved on the final run so I'm pretty happy still."

🗣️ did you have the pace to fight for the pole? "Uh I don't think so, no. I mean I think the first lap felt quite good. I tried to see if anyone wanted to go in front out of the pitlane but no one did. I knew it was always gonna be difficult and just misjudged the braking a little bit and locked up. Yeah, that was the session but good to have a decent result at least. It's been a little while so I'll take it!"

When I set our goal at $810, I tried to choose a number that felt realistic for us to reach by the end of September. I was a little hesitant about setting it even this high, knowing that so many of us are still in school/uni or in the early stages of our careers. I wanted to give us something to work towards without creating any pressure for anyone to give more than they comfortably could. But what I really… truly didn’t expect was that in less than 24 hours, we would raise ALMOST TRIPLE that amount! 😭💙 More than $2400 with the official and additional fundraiser combined! I am so incredibly grateful to every person who has donated, shared, or helped this fundraiser reach more people. I don't think I'll ever stop being amazed by what this community can accomplish when we decide to come together for something that matters. I know I keep saying thank you, but I genuinely don't know how else to put into words how grateful I am to be part of a community like this. Our little 🐝hive is a special one. And a huge thank you as well to everyone from the wider f1twt. I’ve also seen so many people participating from all corners of this community and it makes me so happy to see us all come together for causes like this (even if we spend a lot of our time here arguing about racing). :) I hppe we can keep this going throughout September and rally around similar initiatives in the future. 👊 And of course, happy quali day!
